g.text: Dark spanwise edges: leading edges (LE). Opposite aft edges: trailing edges (TE).
Gold members: interplane struts. Blue arrows: upward lift, larger on one side and smaller on the other.
Twist is exaggerated. This is an illustrative biplane, not measured Flyer CAD or an exact bracing arrangement.
